faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mungeli Samagra Shiksha recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Mungeli Samagra Shiksha recruitment is 08-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by Samagra Shiksha Mungeli?
faq.answer: Samagra Shiksha Mungeli has released a total of 16 vacancies for the posts of Part Time Yoga/Sports Trainer and Music Trainer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Part Time Yoga/Sports Trainer post?
faq.answer: For the Part Time Yoga/Sports Trainer position, candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or Yoga from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for these contractual positions will receive a salary of Rs. 10000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Mungeli Samagra Shiksha recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum age requirement for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the creation of a Merit List based on academic percentages (25% 10th + 25% 12th + 50% Graduation) followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q9. Does the notification mention any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is applicable as per Chhattisgarh Government rules for SC/ST/OBC/Women and other categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Samagra Shiksha Mungeli. Links are provided in the Important Links section.
